name: matrix-bridge-plugin
description: Self-hosted Matrix bridge for AI coding CLIs — privacy-first voice and text chat from your phone

interface.shortDescription: Mirror each coding session into a Matrix room and chat back from your phone
interface.longDescription: One Matrix room per session on your own homeserver. Assistant messages, tool activity, and completion notifications are forwarded in near real time; replies from any Matrix client are injected into the running CLI through tmux. Optional voice replies, per-machine avatars, and session titles shared with tmux.
defaultPrompt: Go mobile: switch replies to a spoken style.
Stop mobile: back to normal replies.
